/Q — THE DETAILS

Cookies &
browser storage.

What is stored in your browser, and why.

Terms & conditionsPrivacy policyCookies policyContact QIXARC ↗

Last updated: 21 October 2026

01

The current setup

The website does not intentionally install advertising trackers or marketing analytics cookies. The interface uses sessionStorage for temporary state. Hosting and security providers may use their own necessary mechanisms when serving or protecting the site.

02

Interface state

Temporary session entries remember the short loading introduction, page navigation transitions and whether the Qbit help nudge has appeared. This state stays in your browser tab and is not submitted with an enquiry.

03

Administrator sessions

After an administrator signs in, Supabase Auth stores the session in this tab’s sessionStorage under qixarc-admin-session. This is necessary for the protected inbox to work. It is not an advertising identifier. Signing out clears the authentication session.

04

Your controls

You can clear site data from your browser settings or close the tab to clear its sessionStorage. Browser storage settings can affect website features, particularly enquiry delivery and administrator sign-in. If the form cannot connect, you can email QIXARC directly. The site also follows your device’s reduced-motion setting.

05

Third-party links

Opening a linked portfolio, social network or product website may introduce that service’s cookies or storage. Check its own policy. Questions about this website can be sent to qixarc@gmail.com.

Questions about this page? qixarc@gmail.com ↗
